description: This file defines the 'HomeScreen' widget for a Flutter mobile application. It includes UI components such as app bar, body with refreshable list, navigation, and embedded widgets like InstagramButton and ReviewsButton. It also contains internal stateless widgets for story card, hours/contact info, and bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Stateless widget representing the main home screen of the app with app bar, refreshable content, category chips, social buttons, and bottom navigation.

classes.name: _StoryCard
classes.description: Internal widget displaying the restaurant story in a card format.

classes.name: _HoursAndContact
classes.description: Internal widget showing hours of operation and contact options, with buttons for call, WhatsApp, directions, and share location.

classes.name: _BottomNav
classes.description: Internal widget providing the bottom navigation bar with four destinations: Home, Menu, Orders, Profile.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for each widget, constructing the widget tree for HomeScreen, _StoryCard, _HoursAndContact, and _BottomNav.
